description: A filtered page of the ledger, plus the totals over every matching row — not just the page. Filter by date range, account, category, uncategorized-only, merchant search and amount bounds; sort by date, charge date, merchant, category or amount. Use this to answer "what did I spend at X" and to show the evidence behind any figure.

account_id.description: Restrict to one account. Ids come from `accounts` in `document_info`.

category_id.description: Restrict to one category. Ids come from `category_tree`.

from.description: Inclusive start of the charge-date range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

include_subcategories.description: Read `category_id` as a parent and include its children. Default false, matching the app own picker, where choosing Utilities means Utilities.

max.description: Largest amount, by magnitude, in major units of the document currency.

min.description: Smallest amount, by magnitude, in major units of the document currency. 200 matches a 200 refund as well as a 200 charge.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

search.description: Matched against the merchant as written, the normalized merchant, and the provider label.

sort.description: One of DATE, CHARGED, MERCHANT, CATEGORY, AMOUNT. Default DATE.

to.description: Inclusive end of the charge-date range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

uncategorized.description: Only rows with no category. Overrides `category_id`.

name: transactions
title: Transactions
